distrust.en: Repeated errors can create distrust between users and a service provider.
distrust.zh: 一再出錯可能造成使用者與服務提供者之間的不信任。

disturbing.en: The report described a disturbing pattern of repeated rule violations.
disturbing.zh: 報告描述了一種令人不安的重複違規模式。

divorcee.en: The novel includes a divorcee starting a new career abroad.
divorcee.zh: 小說中有一位離婚者在海外展開新職涯。

dogmatic.en: A dogmatic approach can prevent useful ideas from being considered.
dogmatic.zh: 教條式的做法可能阻礙有用想法被納入考量。

dole.en: The article explains the historical meaning of the word dole.
dole.zh: 文章說明 dole 這個字的歷史用法。

done.en: The assignment was done before the class ended.
done.zh: 這份作業在下課前就完成了。

doubtless.en: She will doubtless improve if she continues practicing regularly.
doubtless.zh: 如果持續規律練習，她無疑會進步。

drainage.en: Good drainage helps prevent water from collecting on the field.
drainage.zh: 良好的排水可避免場地積水。

drape.en: They chose to drape a cloth over the display table.
drape.zh: 他們選擇在展示桌上鋪一塊布。

drawback.en: One drawback of the plan is its high maintenance cost.
drawback.zh: 這項計畫的一個缺點是維護成本很高。

dropout.en: The study examines factors linked to school dropout rates.
dropout.zh: 這項研究探討與輟學率相關的因素。

duke.en: The history lesson mentioned a duke who governed the region.
duke.zh: 歷史課提到一位曾治理該地區的公爵。

dutiful.en: The dutiful assistant carefully completed every assigned task.
dutiful.zh: 盡責的助理仔細完成了每一項交辦工作。

dweller.en: Each city dweller experiences public space in a different way.
dweller.zh: 每位城市居民對公共空間都有不同體驗。

eagerly.en: Students eagerly opened the boxes containing their science materials.
eagerly.zh: 學生們迫不及待地打開裝著科學材料的箱子。

earnings.en: The report compares company earnings across the last five years.
earnings.zh: 報告比較公司過去五年的收益。

earplug.en: Each musician received an earplug for the loud rehearsal environment.
earplug.zh: 每位樂手都拿到一個耳塞，以因應較大的排練音量。

earthworm.en: An earthworm helps mix organic matter into garden soil.
earthworm.zh: 蚯蚓有助於把有機物混入花園土壤中。

easter.en: The article explains how easter traditions vary across countries.
easter.zh: 文章說明各國的復活節傳統如何不同。

eastwards.en: The birds continued eastwards as the weather grew warmer.
eastwards.zh: 天氣轉暖時，鳥群持續向東飛行。

economically.en: The new design is economically practical for small organizations.
economically.zh: 這項新設計在經濟上對小型組織相當實際。

educated.en: An educated guess can still be improved with better evidence.
educated.zh: 有根據的推測仍可透過更好的證據加以改進。

educator.en: The educator encouraged students to ask deeper questions.
educator.zh: 那位教育工作者鼓勵學生提出更深入的問題。

eel.en: An eel moved slowly through the shallow coastal water.
eel.zh: 一條鰻魚緩慢游過淺海水域。

eight.en: Eight students volunteered to help organize the school event.
eight.zh: 有八位學生自願協助籌辦校內活動。

eighteen.en: The class collected eighteen responses during the first survey.
eighteen.zh: 班上在第一次調查中收集到十八份回覆。

eighty.en: The hall can hold about eighty people at one time.
eighty.zh: 這座大廳一次大約可容納八十人。

elective.en: She chose photography as an elective course this semester.
elective.zh: 她這學期選了攝影作為選修課。

elemental.en: The exhibit introduces elemental ideas in chemistry for beginners.
elemental.zh: 展覽向初學者介紹化學中的基本概念。

eleven.en: Eleven teams entered the competition before registration closed.
eleven.zh: 報名截止前共有十一支隊伍參賽。

elite.en: The article questions whether elite schools receive too many resources.
elite.zh: 文章質疑菁英學校是否獲得過多資源。

e-mail.en: Please send the completed form by e-mail before Friday.
e-mail.zh: 請在週五前用電子郵件寄出填好的表格。

embargo.en: The news outlet respected the embargo until the official announcement.
embargo.zh: 新聞機構遵守禁發規定，直到官方公布為止。

embark.en: The research team will embark on a new project next month.
embark.zh: 研究團隊下個月將展開一項新計畫。

embody.en: These examples embody the main principles discussed in class.
embody.zh: 這些例子體現了課堂中討論的主要原則。

embryo.en: The biology textbook includes a diagram of an early embryo.
embryo.zh: 生物課本中有一張早期胚胎的示意圖。

enchant.en: The old garden can enchant visitors with its quiet beauty.
enchant.zh: 這座老花園能以寧靜之美吸引遊客。

encouraging.en: The latest survey results are encouraging for the student project.
encouraging.zh: 最新調查結果對學生專題來說令人振奮。

endless.en: The discussion seemed endless until the group set a clear deadline.
endless.zh: 直到小組訂下明確期限前，討論似乎沒有盡頭。

enlist.en: The club hopes to enlist more volunteers for the campus event.
enlist.zh: 社團希望為校園活動招募更多志工。

ensue.en: Confusion may ensue if the instructions are changed without notice.
ensue.zh: 若未通知就更改指示，可能隨之產生混亂。

entail.en: The proposal would entail additional training for all staff members.
entail.zh: 這項提案將意味著所有員工都需要額外訓練。

envisage.en: The planners envisage a quieter and greener city center.
envisage.zh: 規劃者設想一個更安靜、更綠化的市中心。

enzyme.en: An enzyme can speed up a chemical reaction in living cells.
enzyme.zh: 酵素可以加速活細胞中的化學反應。

epic.en: The class read an epic poem from an ancient literary tradition.
epic.zh: 班上閱讀了一首來自古代文學傳統的史詩。

epigram.en: The author opened the chapter with a short epigram.
epigram.zh: 作者用一句簡短警句作為章節開頭。

err.en: Even experienced researchers can err when data is incomplete.
err.zh: 即使有經驗的研究者，在資料不完整時也可能犯錯。

essentially.en: The two explanations are essentially the same in meaning.
essentially.zh: 這兩種解釋在意義上基本相同。

etiquette.en: Good classroom etiquette includes listening while others are speaking.
etiquette.zh: 良好的課堂禮儀包括在別人發言時專心聆聽。

exceedingly.en: The final puzzle was exceedingly difficult for most participants.
exceedingly.zh: 最後一道謎題對多數參與者來說極為困難。
